verses.original: וְאֵ֛לֶּה תּוֹלְדֹ֥ת אַהֲרֹ֖ן וּמֹשֶׁ֑ה בְּי֗וֹם דִּבֶּ֧ר יְהוָ֛ה אֶת־ מֹשֶׁ֖ה בְּהַ֥ר סִינָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’êl·leh tō·wl·ḏōṯ ’a·hă·rōn ū·mō·šeh bə·yō·wm dib·ber Yah·weh ’eṯ- mō·šeh bə·har sî·nāy
verses.literal: This is the account of Aaron and Moses at the time the LORD spoke with Moses on Mount Sinai
verses.literalPt: Estas, pois, são as gerações de Arão e de Moisés, no dia em que Jeová falou com Moisés no monte Sinai.

verses.original: וְאֵ֛לֶּה שְׁמ֥וֹת בְּֽנֵי־ אַהֲרֹ֖ן הַבְּכ֣וֹר׀ נָדָ֑ב וַאֲבִיה֕וּא אֶלְעָזָ֖ר וְאִיתָמָֽר׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’êl·leh šə·mō·wṯ bə·nê- ’a·hă·rōn hab·bə·ḵō·wr nā·ḏāḇ wa·’ă·ḇî·hū ’el·‘ā·zār wə·’î·ṯā·mār
verses.literal: These are the names of the sons of Aaron Nadab the firstborn then Abihu Eleazar and Ithamar
verses.literalPt: Estes são os nomes dos filhos de Arão: Nadabe, o primogênito, Abiú, Eleazar e Itamar.

verses.original: אֵ֗לֶּה שְׁמוֹת֙ בְּנֵ֣י אַהֲרֹ֔ן הַכֹּהֲנִ֖ים הַמְּשֻׁחִ֑ים אֲשֶׁר־ מִלֵּ֥א יָדָ֖ם לְכַהֵֽן׃
verses.transliteration: ’êl·leh šə·mō·wṯ bə·nê ’a·hă·rōn hak·kō·hă·nîm ham·mə·šu·ḥîm ’ă·šer- mil·lê yā·ḏām lə·ḵa·hên
verses.literal: These were Aaron’s sons the anointed priests who were ordained . . . to serve as priests
verses.literalPt: Estes são os nomes dos filhos de Arão, dos sacerdotes que foram ungidos, a quem ele consagrou para exercerem as funções do sacerdócio.

verses.original: וַיָּ֣מָת נָדָ֣ב וַאֲבִיה֣וּא לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֡ה בְּֽהַקְרִבָם֩ אֵ֨שׁ זָרָ֜ה לִפְנֵ֤י יְהוָה֙ בְּמִדְבַּ֣ר סִינַ֔י וּבָנִ֖ים לֹא־ הָי֣וּ לָהֶ֑ם וַיְכַהֵ֤ן אֶלְעָזָר֙ וְאִ֣יתָמָ֔ר עַל־ פְּנֵ֖י אַהֲרֹ֥ן אֲבִיהֶֽם׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·yā·māṯ nā·ḏāḇ wa·’ă·ḇî·hū lip̄·nê Yah·weh bə·haq·ri·ḇām ’êš zā·rāh lip̄·nê Yah·weh bə·miḏ·bar sî·nay ū·ḇā·nîm lō- hā·yū lā·hem way·ḵa·hên ’el·‘ā·zār wə·’î·ṯā·mār ‘al- pə·nê ’a·hă·rōn ’ă·ḇî·hem
verses.literal: Nadab and Abihu, however died in the presence of the LORD when they offered unauthorized fire before the LORD in the Wilderness of Sinai And since they had no sons only Eleazar and Ithamar served as priests during the lifetime of their father Aaron
verses.literalPt: Nadabe e Abiú morreram diante de Jeová, quando ofereceram fogo estranho diante dele no deserto de Sinai, e não tiveram filhos; e Eleazar e Itamar exerceram as funções do sacerdócio na presença de seu pai Arão.

verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·ḏab·bêr Yah·weh ’el- mō·šeh lê·mōr
verses.literal: Then the LORD said to Moses . . .
verses.literalPt: Disse Jeová a Moisés:

verses.original: הַקְרֵב֙ אֶת־ מַטֵּ֣ה לֵוִ֔י וְֽהַעֲמַדְתָּ֣ אֹת֔וֹ לִפְנֵ֖י אַהֲרֹ֣ן הַכֹּהֵ֑ן וְשֵׁרְת֖וּ אֹתֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: haq·rêḇ ’eṯ- maṭ·ṭêh lê·wî wə·ha·‘ă·maḏ·tā ’ō·ṯōw lip̄·nê ’a·hă·rōn hak·kō·hên wə·šê·rə·ṯū ’ō·ṯōw
verses.literal: Bring the tribe of Levi and present them to Aaron the priest to assist him
verses.literalPt: Faze chegar a tribo de Levi e coloca-os diante do sacerdote Arão, para o servirem.

verses.original: וְשָׁמְר֣וּ אֶת־ מִשְׁמַרְתּ֗וֹ וְאֶת־ מִשְׁמֶ֙רֶת֙ כָּל־ הָ֣עֵדָ֔ה לִפְנֵ֖י אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֑ד לַעֲבֹ֖ד אֶת־ עֲבֹדַ֥ת הַמִּשְׁכָּֽן׃
verses.transliteration: wə·šā·mə·rū ’eṯ- miš·mar·tōw wə·’eṯ- miš·me·reṯ kāl- hā·‘ê·ḏāh lip̄·nê ’ō·hel mō·w·‘êḏ la·‘ă·ḇōḏ ’eṯ- ‘ă·ḇō·ḏaṯ ham·miš·kān
verses.literal: They are to perform duties for him - and for the whole congregation before the Tent of Meeting attending to the service of the tabernacle
verses.literalPt: Eles cumprirão o que lhe é devido a ele e a toda a congregação perante a tenda da revelação, para fazerem o serviço do tabernáculo.

verses.original: וְשָׁמְר֗וּ אֶֽת־ כָּל־ כְּלֵי֙ אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֔ד וְאֶת־ מִשְׁמֶ֖רֶת בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל לַעֲבֹ֖ד אֶת־ עֲבֹדַ֥ת הַמִּשְׁכָּֽן׃
verses.transliteration: wə·šā·mə·rū ’eṯ- kāl- kə·lê ’ō·hel mō·w·‘êḏ wə·’eṯ- miš·me·reṯ bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl la·‘ă·ḇōḏ ’eṯ- ‘ă·ḇō·ḏaṯ ham·miš·kān
verses.literal: They shall take care of all the furnishings of the Tent of Meeting and fulfill obligations for the Israelites . . . by attending to the service of the tabernacle
verses.literalPt: Guardarão todos os móveis da tenda da revelação e cumprirão com o que está prescrito aos filhos de Israel, para fazerem o serviço do tabernáculo.

verses.original: וְנָתַתָּה֙ אֶת־ הַלְוִיִּ֔ם לְאַהֲרֹ֖ן וּלְבָנָ֑יו נְתוּנִ֨ם נְתוּנִ֥ם הֵ֙מָּה֙ ל֔וֹ מֵאֵ֖ת בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: wə·nā·ṯat·tāh ’eṯ- hal·wî·yim lə·’a·hă·rōn ū·lə·ḇā·nāw nə·ṯū·nim nə·ṯū·nim hêm·māh lōw mê·’êṯ bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: Assign the Levites to Aaron and his sons they have been given exclusively . . . to him from among the Israelites . . .
verses.literalPt: Darás os levitas a Arão e a seus filhos; certamente, eles lhe são dados da parte dos filhos de Israel.

verses.original: וְאֶת־ אַהֲרֹ֤ן וְאֶת־ בָּנָיו֙ תִּפְקֹ֔ד וְשָׁמְר֖וּ אֶת־ כְּהֻנָּתָ֑ם וְהַזָּ֥ר הַקָּרֵ֖ב יוּמָֽת׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·’eṯ- ’a·hă·rōn wə·’eṯ- bā·nāw tip̄·qōḏ wə·šā·mə·rū ’eṯ- kə·hun·nā·ṯām wə·haz·zār haq·qā·rêḇ yū·māṯ
verses.literal: So you shall appoint Aaron and his sons to carry out the duties of the priesthood but any outsider who approaches the tabernacle must be put to death
verses.literalPt: Designarás a Arão e a seus filhos, os quais guardarão o seu sacerdócio; o estrangeiro que se chegar será morto.

verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·ḏab·bêr Yah·weh ’el- mō·šeh lê·mōr
verses.literal: Again the LORD spoke to Moses saying
verses.literalPt: Disse mais Jeová a Moisés:

verses.original: וַאֲנִ֞י הִנֵּ֧ה לָקַ֣חְתִּי אֶת־ הַלְוִיִּ֗ם מִתּוֹךְ֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל תַּ֧חַת כָּל־ בְּכ֛וֹר פֶּ֥טֶר רֶ֖חֶם מִבְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְהָ֥יוּ לִ֖י הַלְוִיִּֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wa·’ă·nî hin·nêh lā·qaḥ·tî ’eṯ- hal·wî·yim mit·tō·wḵ bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl ta·ḥaṯ kāl- bə·ḵō·wr pe·ṭer re·ḥem mib·bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl wə·hā·yū lî hal·wî·yim
verses.literal: Behold I have taken the Levites from among the children of Israel in place of every . . . firstborn Israelite . . . from the womb The Levites belong to Me
verses.literalPt: Eu, eis que eu tenho tomado os levitas dentre os filhos de Israel em lugar de todo primogênito que abre a madre entre os filhos de Israel, e os levitas serão meus;

verses.original: כִּ֣י לִי֮ כָּל־ בְּכוֹר֒ בְּיוֹם֩ הַכֹּתִ֨י כָל־ בְּכ֜וֹר בְּאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֗יִם הִקְדַּ֨שְׁתִּי לִ֤י כָל־ בְּכוֹר֙ בְּיִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל מֵאָדָ֖ם עַד־ בְּהֵמָ֑ה לִ֥י יִהְי֖וּ אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: kî lî kāl- bə·ḵō·wr bə·yō·wm hak·kō·ṯî ḵāl bə·ḵō·wr bə·’e·reṣ miṣ·ra·yim hiq·daš·tî lî ḵāl bə·ḵō·wr bə·yiś·rā·’êl mê·’ā·ḏām ‘aḏ- bə·hê·māh lî yih·yū ’ă·nî Yah·weh
verses.literal: for all the firstborn are Mine On the day I struck down every firstborn in the land of Egypt I consecrated to Myself all the firstborn in Israel both man and beast They are Mine I am the LORD
verses.literalPt: pois todos os primogênitos são meus. No dia em que feri todos os primogênitos na terra do Egito, consagrei para mim todos os primogênitos em Israel, desde o homem até o animal; serão meus. Eu sou Jeová.

verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֤ר יְהוָה֙ אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֔ה בְּמִדְבַּ֥ר סִינַ֖י לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·ḏab·bêr Yah·weh ’el- mō·šeh bə·miḏ·bar sî·nay lê·mōr
verses.literal: Then the LORD spoke to Moses in the Wilderness of Sinai saying
verses.literalPt: Disse ainda Jeová a Moisés, no deserto de Sinai:

verses.original: פְּקֹד֙ אֶת־ בְּנֵ֣י לֵוִ֔י לְבֵ֥ית אֲבֹתָ֖ם לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֑ם כָּל־ זָכָ֛ר מִבֶּן־ חֹ֥דֶשׁ וָמַ֖עְלָה תִּפְקְדֵֽם׃
verses.transliteration: pə·qōḏ ’eṯ- bə·nê lê·wî lə·ḇêṯ ’ă·ḇō·ṯām lə·miš·pə·ḥō·ṯām kāl- zā·ḵār mib·ben- ḥō·ḏeš wā·ma‘·lāh tip̄·qə·ḏêm
verses.literal: Number the Levites . . . by their families . . . and clans You are to count every male a month old or more
verses.literalPt: Conta os filhos de Levi pelas casas de seus pais, pelas suas famílias; contarás a todo o homem de idade de um mês e daí para cima.

verses.original: וַיִּפְקֹ֥ד אֹתָ֛ם מֹשֶׁ֖ה עַל־ פִּ֣י יְהוָ֑ה כַּאֲשֶׁ֖ר צֻוָּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yip̄·qōḏ ’ō·ṯām mō·šeh ‘al- pî Yah·weh ka·’ă·šer ṣuw·wāh
verses.literal: So Moses numbered them according to the word of the LORD as he had been commanded
verses.literalPt: Moisés os contou segundo a palavra de Jeová, assim como lhe foi ordenado.

verses.original: וַיִּֽהְיוּ־ אֵ֥לֶּה בְנֵֽי־ לֵוִ֖י בִּשְׁמֹתָ֑ם גֵּרְשׁ֕וֹן וּקְהָ֖ת וּמְרָרִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: way·yih·yū- ’êl·leh ḇə·nê- lê·wî biš·mō·ṯām gê·rə·šō·wn ū·qə·hāṯ ū·mə·rā·rî
verses.literal: These were the sons of Levi by name Gershon Kohath and Merari
verses.literalPt: Estes são os filhos de Levi pelos seus nomes: Gérson, Coate e Merari.

verses.original: וְאֵ֛לֶּה שְׁמ֥וֹת בְּֽנֵי־ גֵרְשׁ֖וֹן לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֑ם לִבְנִ֖י וְשִׁמְעִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’êl·leh šə·mō·wṯ bə·nê- ḡê·rə·šō·wn lə·miš·pə·ḥō·ṯām liḇ·nî wə·šim·‘î
verses.literal: These were the names of the sons of Gershon by their clans Libni and Shimei
verses.literalPt: Estes são os nomes dos filhos de Gérson pelas suas famílias: Libni e Simei.

verses.original: וּבְנֵ֥י קְהָ֖ת לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֑ם עַמְרָ֣ם וְיִצְהָ֔ר חֶבְר֖וֹן וְעֻזִּיאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇə·nê qə·hāṯ lə·miš·pə·ḥō·ṯām ‘am·rām wə·yiṣ·hār ḥeḇ·rō·wn wə·‘uz·zî·’êl
verses.literal: The sons of Kohath by their clans were Amram Izhar Hebron and Uzziel
verses.literalPt: Os filhos de Coate pelas suas famílias: Anrão, Jizar, Hebrom e Uziel.

verses.original: וּבְנֵ֧י מְרָרִ֛י לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֖ם מַחְלִ֣י וּמוּשִׁ֑י אֵ֥לֶּה הֵ֛ם מִשְׁפְּחֹ֥ת הַלֵּוִ֖י לְבֵ֥ית אֲבֹתָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇə·nê mə·rā·rî lə·miš·pə·ḥō·ṯām maḥ·lî ū·mū·šî ’êl·leh hêm miš·pə·ḥōṯ hal·lê·wî lə·ḇêṯ ’ă·ḇō·ṯām
verses.literal: And the sons of Merari by their clans were Mahli and Mushi These were the clans of the Levites according to their families . . .
verses.literalPt: Os filhos de Merari pelas suas famílias: Mali e Musi. Estas são as famílias dos levitas segundo as casas de seus pais.

verses.original: לְגֵ֣רְשׁ֔וֹן מִשְׁפַּ֙חַת֙ הַלִּבְנִ֔י וּמִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הַשִּׁמְעִ֑י אֵ֣לֶּה הֵ֔ם מִשְׁפְּחֹ֖ת הַגֵּרְשֻׁנִּֽי׃
verses.transliteration: lə·ḡê·rə·šō·wn miš·pa·ḥaṯ hal·liḇ·nî ū·miš·pa·ḥaṯ haš·šim·‘î ’êl·leh hêm miš·pə·ḥōṯ hag·gê·rə·šun·nî
verses.literal: From Gershon came the Libnite clan and the Shimeite clan these . . . were the Gershonite clans
verses.literalPt: De Gérson era a família dos libnitas e a dos simeítas; estas são as famílias dos gersonitas.

verses.original: פְּקֻדֵיהֶם֙ בְּמִסְפַּ֣ר כָּל־ זָכָ֔ר מִבֶּן־ חֹ֖דֶשׁ וָמָ֑עְלָה פְּקֻ֣דֵיהֶ֔ם שִׁבְעַ֥ת אֲלָפִ֖ים וַחֲמֵ֥שׁ מֵאֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: pə·qu·ḏê·hem bə·mis·par kāl- zā·ḵār mib·ben- ḥō·ḏeš wā·mā·‘ə·lāh pə·qu·ḏê·hem šiḇ·‘aṯ ’ă·lā·p̄îm wa·ḥă·mêš mê·’ō·wṯ
verses.literal: The number . . . of all the males a month old or more was 7,500 . . . . . . . . .
verses.literalPt: Os que foram contados deles, segundo o número de todos os homens, desde a idade de um mês e daí para cima, sim, todos os que deles foram contados eram sete mil e quinhentos.

verses.original: מִשְׁפְּחֹ֖ת הַגֵּרְשֻׁנִּ֑י אַחֲרֵ֧י הַמִּשְׁכָּ֛ן יַחֲנ֖וּ יָֽמָּה׃
verses.transliteration: miš·pə·ḥōṯ hag·gê·rə·šun·nî ’a·ḥă·rê ham·miš·kān ya·ḥă·nū yām·māh
verses.literal: The Gershonite clans were to camp on the west behind the tabernacle
verses.literalPt: As famílias dos gersonitas acampar-se-ão atrás do tabernáculo, ao ocidente.

verses.original: וּנְשִׂ֥יא בֵֽית־ אָ֖ב לַגֵּרְשֻׁנִּ֑י אֶלְיָסָ֖ף בֶּן־ לָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: ū·nə·śî ḇêṯ- ’āḇ lag·gê·rə·šun·nî ’el·yā·sāp̄ ben- lā·’êl
verses.literal: and the leader of the families . . . of the Gershonites was Eliasaph son of Lael
verses.literalPt: O príncipe da casa do pai dos gersonitas será Eliasafe, filho de Lael.

verses.original: וּמִשְׁמֶ֤רֶת בְּנֵֽי־ גֵרְשׁוֹן֙ בְּאֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֔ד הַמִּשְׁכָּ֖ן וְהָאֹ֑הֶל מִכְסֵ֕הוּ וּמָסַ֕ךְ פֶּ֖תַח אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד׃
verses.transliteration: ū·miš·me·reṯ bə·nê- ḡê·rə·šō·wn bə·’ō·hel mō·w·‘êḏ ham·miš·kān wə·hā·’ō·hel miḵ·sê·hū ū·mā·saḵ pe·ṯaḥ ’ō·hel mō·w·‘êḏ
verses.literal: The duties of the Gershonites . . . at the Tent of Meeting were the tabernacle and tent its covering the curtain for the entrance to the Tent of Meeting
verses.literalPt: Os filhos de Gérson terão a seu cargo, na tenda da revelação, o tabernáculo, a tenda e sua coberta, o anteparo para a porta da tenda da revelação,

verses.original: וְקַלְעֵ֣י הֶֽחָצֵ֗ר וְאֶת־ מָסַךְ֙ פֶּ֣תַח הֶֽחָצֵ֔ר אֲשֶׁ֧ר עַל־ הַמִּשְׁכָּ֛ן וְעַל־ הַמִּזְבֵּ֖חַ סָבִ֑יב וְאֵת֙ מֵֽיתָרָ֔יו לְכֹ֖ל עֲבֹדָתֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·qal·‘ê he·ḥā·ṣêr wə·’eṯ- mā·saḵ pe·ṯaḥ he·ḥā·ṣêr ’ă·šer ‘al- ham·miš·kān wə·‘al- ham·miz·bê·aḥ sā·ḇîḇ wə·’êṯ mê·ṯā·rāw lə·ḵōl ‘ă·ḇō·ḏā·ṯōw
verses.literal: the curtains of the courtyard the curtain for the entrance to the courtyard that surrounds the tabernacle . . . and altar . . . and the cords all the service for these items
verses.literalPt: as cortinas do átrio, o anteparo para a entrada do átrio que está junto ao tabernáculo e junto ao altar em redor e as suas cordas para todo o seu serviço.

verses.original: וְלִקְהָ֗ת מִשְׁפַּ֤חַת הַֽעַמְרָמִי֙ וּמִשְׁפַּ֣חַת הַיִּצְהָרִ֔י וּמִשְׁפַּ֙חַת֙ הַֽחֶבְרֹנִ֔י וּמִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הָֽעָזִּיאֵלִ֑י אֵ֥לֶּה הֵ֖ם מִשְׁפְּחֹ֥ת הַקְּהָתִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: wə·liq·hāṯ miš·pa·ḥaṯ ha·‘am·rā·mî ū·miš·pa·ḥaṯ hay·yiṣ·hā·rî ū·miš·pa·ḥaṯ ha·ḥeḇ·rō·nî ū·miš·pa·ḥaṯ hā·‘āz·zî·’ê·lî ’êl·leh hêm miš·pə·ḥōṯ haq·qə·hā·ṯî
verses.literal: From Kohath came the clans of the Amramites the Izharites the Hebronites and the Uzzielites these . . . were the clans of the Kohathites
verses.literalPt: De Coate era a família dos anramitas, e a família dos jizaritas, e a família dos hebronitas, e a família dos uzielitas; estas são as famílias dos coatitas.

verses.original: בְּמִסְפַּר֙ כָּל־ זָכָ֔ר מִבֶּן־ חֹ֖דֶשׁ וָמָ֑עְלָה שְׁמֹנַ֤ת אֲלָפִים֙ וְשֵׁ֣שׁ מֵא֔וֹת שֹׁמְרֵ֖י מִשְׁמֶ֥רֶת הַקֹּֽדֶשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: bə·mis·par kāl- zā·ḵār mib·ben- ḥō·ḏeš wā·mā·‘ə·lāh šə·mō·naṯ ’ă·lā·p̄îm wə·šêš mê·’ō·wṯ šō·mə·rê miš·me·reṯ haq·qō·ḏeš
verses.literal: The number of all the males a month old or more was 8,600 . . . . . . . . . They were responsible for the duties of the sanctuary
verses.literalPt: Segundo o número de todos os homens, desde a idade dum mês e daí para cima, foram oito mil e seiscentos, que tiveram a seu cargo o santuário.

verses.original: מִשְׁפְּחֹ֥ת בְּנֵי־ קְהָ֖ת יַחֲנ֑וּ עַ֛ל יֶ֥רֶךְ הַמִּשְׁכָּ֖ן תֵּימָֽנָה׃
verses.transliteration: miš·pə·ḥōṯ bə·nê- qə·hāṯ ya·ḥă·nū ‘al ye·reḵ ham·miš·kān tê·mā·nāh
verses.literal: The clans of the Kohathites . . . were to camp on the south side of the tabernacle
verses.literalPt: As famílias dos filhos de Coate acampar-se-ão ao lado do tabernáculo, para a banda do sul.

verses.original: וּנְשִׂ֥יא בֵֽית־ אָ֖ב לְמִשְׁפְּחֹ֣ת הַקְּהָתִ֑י אֶלִיצָפָ֖ן בֶּן־ עֻזִּיאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: ū·nə·śî ḇêṯ- ’āḇ lə·miš·pə·ḥōṯ haq·qə·hā·ṯî ʾɛ·lī·ṣå̄·p̄å̄n ben- ‘uz·zî·’êl
verses.literal: and the leader of the families . . . of the Kohathites was Elizaphan son of Uzziel
verses.literalPt: O príncipe da casa do pai das famílias dos coatitas será Elisafã, filho de Uziel.

verses.original: וּמִשְׁמַרְתָּ֗ם הָאָרֹ֤ן וְהַשֻּׁלְחָן֙ וְהַמְּנֹרָ֣ה וְהַֽמִּזְבְּחֹ֔ת וּכְלֵ֣י הַקֹּ֔דֶשׁ אֲשֶׁ֥ר יְשָׁרְת֖וּ בָּהֶ֑ם וְהַ֨מָּסָ֔ךְ וְכֹ֖ל עֲבֹדָתֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ū·miš·mar·tām hā·’ā·rōn wə·haš·šul·ḥān wə·ham·mə·nō·rāh wə·ham·miz·bə·ḥōṯ ū·ḵə·lê haq·qō·ḏeš ’ă·šer yə·šā·rə·ṯū bā·hem wə·ham·mā·sāḵ wə·ḵōl ‘ă·ḇō·ḏā·ṯōw
verses.literal: Their duties were the ark the table the lampstand the altars the articles of the sanctuary used with them and the curtain all the service for these items
verses.literalPt: Eles terão a seu cargo a arca, a mesa, o candeeiro, os altares, e os utensílios do santuário com os quais exercem as funções do seu ministério, e o anteparo, e todo o seu serviço.

verses.original: וּנְשִׂיא֙ נְשִׂיאֵ֣י הַלֵּוִ֔י אֶלְעָזָ֖ר בֶּן־ אַהֲרֹ֣ן הַכֹּהֵ֑ן פְּקֻדַּ֕ת שֹׁמְרֵ֖י מִשְׁמֶ֥רֶת הַקֹּֽדֶשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: ū·nə·śî nə·śî·’ê hal·lê·wî ’el·‘ā·zār ben- ’a·hă·rōn hak·kō·hên pə·qud·daṯ šō·mə·rê miš·me·reṯ haq·qō·ḏeš
verses.literal: The chief of the leaders of the Levites was Eleazar son of Aaron the priest he oversaw those responsible for the duties of the sanctuary
verses.literalPt: Eleazar, filho do sacerdote Arão, será o príncipe dos príncipes dos levitas e terá a superintendência dos que têm a seu cargo o santuário.

verses.original: לִמְרָרִ֕י מִשְׁפַּ֙חַת֙ הַמַּחְלִ֔י וּמִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הַמּוּשִׁ֑י אֵ֥לֶּה הֵ֖ם מִשְׁפְּחֹ֥ת מְרָרִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: lim·rā·rî miš·pa·ḥaṯ ham·maḥ·lî ū·miš·pa·ḥaṯ ham·mū·šî ’êl·leh hêm miš·pə·ḥōṯ mə·rā·rî
verses.literal: From Merari came the clans of the Mahlites and Mushites . . . these . . . were the Merarite clans
verses.literalPt: De Merari era a família dos malitas e a família dos musitas; estas são as famílias de Merari.

verses.original: וּפְקֻדֵיהֶם֙ בְּמִסְפַּ֣ר כָּל־ זָכָ֔ר מִבֶּן־ חֹ֖דֶשׁ וָמָ֑עְלָה שֵׁ֥שֶׁת אֲלָפִ֖ים וּמָאתָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: ū·p̄ə·qu·ḏê·hem bə·mis·par kāl- zā·ḵār mib·ben- ḥō·ḏeš wā·mā·‘ə·lāh šê·šeṯ ’ă·lā·p̄îm ū·mā·ṯā·yim
verses.literal: The number . . . of all the males a month old or more was 6,200 . . . . . .
verses.literalPt: Os que foram contados deles, segundo o número de todos os homens, desde a idade dum mês e daí para cima, eram seis mil e duzentos.

verses.original: וּנְשִׂ֤יא בֵֽית־ אָב֙ לְמִשְׁפְּחֹ֣ת מְרָרִ֔י צוּרִיאֵ֖ל בֶּן־ אֲבִיחָ֑יִל עַ֣ל יֶ֧רֶךְ הַמִּשְׁכָּ֛ן יַחֲנ֖וּ צָפֹֽנָה׃
verses.transliteration: ū·nə·śî ḇêṯ- ’āḇ lə·miš·pə·ḥōṯ mə·rā·rî ṣū·rî·’êl ben- ’ă·ḇî·ḥā·yil ‘al ye·reḵ ham·miš·kān ya·ḥă·nū ṣā·p̄ō·nāh
verses.literal: The leader of the families . . . of the Merarites was Zuriel son of Abihail they were to camp on the north side of the tabernacle
verses.literalPt: O príncipe da casa do pai das famílias de Merari era Zuriel, filho de Abiail; eles se acamparão ao lado do tabernáculo, para a banda do norte.

verses.original: וּפְקֻדַּ֣ת מִשְׁמֶרֶת֮ בְּנֵ֣י מְרָרִי֒ קַרְשֵׁי֙ הַמִּשְׁכָּ֔ן וּבְרִיחָ֖יו וְעַמֻּדָ֣יו וַאֲדָנָ֑יו וְכָל־ כֵּלָ֔יו וְכֹ֖ל עֲבֹדָתֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ū·p̄ə·qud·daṯ miš·me·reṯ bə·nê mə·rā·rî qar·šê ham·miš·kān ū·ḇə·rî·ḥāw wə·‘am·mu·ḏāw wa·’ă·ḏā·nāw wə·ḵāl kê·lāw wə·ḵōl ‘ă·ḇō·ḏā·ṯōw
verses.literal: The duties assigned to the sons of Merari were the tabernacle’s frames crossbars posts bases and all its equipment all the service for these items
verses.literalPt: Por designação, os filhos de Merari terão a seu cargo as peças do tabernáculo, as suas travessas, as suas colunas, as suas bases e todos os seus pertences, e todo o seu serviço,

verses.original: וְעַמֻּדֵ֧י הֶחָצֵ֛ר סָבִ֖יב וְאַדְנֵיהֶ֑ם וִיתֵדֹתָ֖ם וּמֵֽיתְרֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘am·mu·ḏê he·ḥā·ṣêr sā·ḇîḇ wə·’aḏ·nê·hem wî·ṯê·ḏō·ṯām ū·mê·ṯə·rê·hem
verses.literal: as well as the posts of the surrounding courtyard with their bases tent pegs and ropes
verses.literalPt: as colunas do átrio ao redor, as suas bases, os seus pregos e as suas cordas.

verses.original: וְהַחֹנִ֣ים לִפְנֵ֣י הַמִּשְׁכָּ֡ן קֵ֣דְמָה לִפְנֵי֩ אֹֽהֶל־ מוֹעֵ֨ד׀ מִזְרָ֜חָה מֹשֶׁ֣ה׀ וְאַהֲרֹ֣ן וּבָנָ֗יו שֹֽׁמְרִים֙ מִשְׁמֶ֣רֶת הַמִּקְדָּ֔שׁ לְמִשְׁמֶ֖רֶת בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְהַזָּ֥ר הַקָּרֵ֖ב יוּמָֽת׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ha·ḥō·nîm lip̄·nê ham·miš·kān qê·ḏə·māh lip̄·nê ’ō·hel- mō·w·‘êḏ miz·rā·ḥāh mō·šeh wə·’a·hă·rōn ū·ḇā·nāw šō·mə·rîm miš·me·reṯ ham·miq·dāš lə·miš·me·reṯ bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl wə·haz·zār haq·qā·rêḇ yū·māṯ
verses.literal: Moses Aaron and Aaron’s sons were to camp to the east of the tabernacle toward the sunrise before the Tent of Meeting They were to perform the duties of the sanctuary as a service on behalf of the Israelites but any outsider who approached the sanctuary was to be put to death
verses.literalPt: Os que se acamparem diante do tabernáculo, para a banda do oriente, diante da tenda da revelação, para o nascente, serão Moisés, e Arão, e seus filhos, que têm a seu cargo o santuário, para cumprirem o que está prescrito aos filhos de Israel; o estrangeiro que se chegar será morto.

verses.original: כָּל־ פְּקוּדֵ֨י הַלְוִיִּ֜ם אֲשֶׁר֩ פָּקַ֨ד מֹשֶׁ֧ה וְׄאַׄהֲׄרֹ֛ׄןׄ עַל־ פִּ֥י יְהוָ֖ה לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֑ם כָּל־ זָכָר֙ מִבֶּן־ חֹ֣דֶשׁ וָמַ֔עְלָה שְׁנַ֥יִם וְעֶשְׂרִ֖ים אָֽלֶף׃ס
verses.transliteration: kāl- pə·qū·ḏê hal·wî·yim ’ă·šer pā·qaḏ mō·šeh wə·ʾa·hă·rōn ‘al- pî Yah·weh lə·miš·pə·ḥō·ṯām kāl- zā·ḵār mib·ben- ḥō·ḏeš wā·ma‘·lāh šə·na·yim wə·‘eś·rîm ’ā·lep̄
verses.literal: The total number of Levites that Moses and Aaron counted by their clans at the LORD’s command including all the males a month old or more was 22,000 . . . . . .
verses.literalPt: Todos os que foram contados dos levitas, aos quais contaram Moisés e Arão, segundo o mandamento de Jeová, pelas suas famílias, todos os homens, desde a idade dum mês e daí para cima, eram vinte e dois mil.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֜ה אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֗ה פְּקֹ֨ד כָּל־ בְּכֹ֤ר זָכָר֙ לִבְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל מִבֶּן־ חֹ֖דֶשׁ וָמָ֑עְלָה וְשָׂ֕א אֵ֖ת מִסְפַּ֥ר שְׁמֹתָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer Yah·weh ’el- mō·šeh pə·qōḏ kāl- bə·ḵōr zā·ḵār liḇ·nê yiś·rā·’êl mib·ben- ḥō·ḏeš wā·mā·‘ə·lāh wə·śā ’êṯ mis·par šə·mō·ṯām
verses.literal: Then the LORD . . . said to Moses Number every firstborn male of the Israelites a month old or more and list - their names
verses.literalPt: Disse mais Jeová a Moisés: Contarás todos os primogênitos dos filhos de Israel, desde a idade dum mês e daí para cima, e tomarás o número dos seus nomes.

verses.original: וְלָקַחְתָּ֨ אֶת־ הַלְוִיִּ֥ם לִי֙ אֲנִ֣י יְהוָ֔ה תַּ֥חַת כָּל־ בְּכֹ֖ר בִּבְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְאֵת֙ בֶּהֱמַ֣ת הַלְוִיִּ֔ם תַּ֣חַת כָּל־ בְּכ֔וֹר בְּבֶהֱמַ֖ת בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: wə·lā·qaḥ·tā ’eṯ- hal·wî·yim lî ’ă·nî Yah·weh ta·ḥaṯ kāl- bə·ḵōr biḇ·nê yiś·rā·’êl wə·’êṯ be·hĕ·maṯ hal·wî·yim ta·ḥaṯ kāl- bə·ḵō·wr bə·ḇe·hĕ·maṯ bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: You are to take the Levites for Me I am the LORD in place of all the firstborn of Israel and the livestock of the Levites in place of all the firstborn of the livestock of the Israelites
verses.literalPt: Tomarás os levitas para mim (eu sou Jeová) em lugar de todos os primogênitos entre os filhos de Israel e o gado dos levitas em lugar de todos os primogênitos entre o gado dos filhos de Israel.

verses.original: וַיִּפְקֹ֣ד מֹשֶׁ֔ה כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֹת֑וֹ אֶֽת־ כָּל־ בְּכֹ֖ר בִּבְנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: way·yip̄·qōḏ mō·šeh ka·’ă·šer ṣiw·wāh Yah·weh ’ō·ṯōw ’eṯ- kāl- bə·ḵōr biḇ·nê yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: So Moses numbered all the firstborn of the Israelites as the LORD had commanded him
verses.literalPt: Moisés contou, como Jeová lhe ordenou, todos os primogênitos entre os filhos de Israel.

verses.original: וַיְהִי֩ כָל־ בְּכ֨וֹר זָכָ֜ר בְּמִסְפַּ֥ר שֵׁמ֛וֹת מִבֶּן־ חֹ֥דֶשׁ וָמַ֖עְלָה לִפְקֻדֵיהֶ֑ם שְׁנַ֤יִם וְעֶשְׂרִים֙ אֶ֔לֶף שְׁלֹשָׁ֥ה וְשִׁבְעִ֖ים וּמָאתָֽיִם׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·hî ḵāl bə·ḵō·wr zā·ḵār bə·mis·par šê·mō·wṯ mib·ben- ḥō·ḏeš wā·ma‘·lāh lip̄·qu·ḏê·hem šə·na·yim wə·‘eś·rîm ’e·lep̄ šə·lō·šāh wə·šiḇ·‘îm ū·mā·ṯā·yim
verses.literal: The total number of the firstborn males a month old or more listed by name was 22,273 . . . . . . . . . . . . . . .
verses.literalPt: Todos os primogênitos, segundo o número dos nomes, desde a idade dum mês e daí para cima, dos que foram contados, eram vinte e dois mil e duzentos e setenta e três.

verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·ḏab·bêr Yah·weh ’el- mō·šeh lê·mōr
verses.literal: Again the LORD spoke to Moses saying
verses.literalPt: Disse Jeová a Moisés:

verses.original: קַ֣ח אֶת־ הַלְוִיִּ֗ם תַּ֤חַת כָּל־ בְּכוֹר֙ בִּבְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְאֶת־ בֶּהֱמַ֥ת הַלְוִיִּ֖ם תַּ֣חַת בְּהֶמְתָּ֑ם וְהָיוּ־ לִ֥י הַלְוִיִּ֖ם אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: qaḥ ’eṯ- hal·wî·yim ta·ḥaṯ kāl- bə·ḵō·wr biḇ·nê yiś·rā·’êl wə·’eṯ- be·hĕ·maṯ hal·wî·yim ta·ḥaṯ bə·hem·tām wə·hā·yū- lî hal·wî·yim ’ă·nî Yah·weh
verses.literal: Take the Levites in place of all the firstborn of Israel and the livestock of the Levites in place of their livestock The Levites belong to Me I am the LORD
verses.literalPt: Toma os levitas em lugar de todos os primogênitos entre os filhos de Israel e o gado dos levitas em lugar do gado deles; os levitas serão meus. Eu sou Jeová.

verses.original: וְאֵת֙ פְּדוּיֵ֣י הַשְּׁלֹשָׁ֔ה וְהַשִּׁבְעִ֖ים וְהַמָּאתָ֑יִם הָעֹֽדְפִים֙ עַל־ הַלְוִיִּ֔ם מִבְּכ֖וֹר בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’êṯ pə·ḏū·yê haš·šə·lō·šāh wə·haš·šiḇ·‘îm wə·ham·mā·ṯā·yim hā·‘ō·ḏə·p̄îm ‘al- hal·wî·yim mib·bə·ḵō·wr bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: To redeem the 273 . . . . . . firstborn Israelites . . . who outnumber . . . the Levites
verses.literalPt: Pela redenção dos duzentos e setenta e três dos primogênitos dos filhos de Israel, que excedem o número dos levitas,

verses.original: וְלָקַחְתָּ֗ חֲמֵ֧שֶׁת חֲמֵ֛שֶׁת שְׁקָלִ֖ים לַגֻּלְגֹּ֑לֶת בְּשֶׁ֤קֶל הַקֹּ֙דֶשׁ֙ תִּקָּ֔ח עֶשְׂרִ֥ים גֵּרָ֖ה הַשָּֽׁקֶל׃
verses.transliteration: wə·lā·qaḥ·tā ḥă·mê·šeṯ ḥă·mê·šeṯ šə·qā·lîm lag·gul·gō·leṯ bə·še·qel haq·qō·ḏeš tiq·qāḥ ‘eś·rîm gê·rāh haš·šā·qel
verses.literal: you are to collect five . . . shekels for each one according to the sanctuary . . . shekel of twenty gerahs . . .
verses.literalPt: receberás cinco siclos por cabeça; recebê-los-ás segundo o siclo do santuário (o siclo tem vinte óbolos)

verses.original: וְנָתַתָּ֣ה הַכֶּ֔סֶף לְאַהֲרֹ֖ן וּלְבָנָ֑יו פְּדוּיֵ֕י הָעֹדְפִ֖ים בָּהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·nā·ṯat·tāh hak·ke·sep̄ lə·’a·hă·rōn ū·lə·ḇā·nāw pə·ḏū·yê hā·‘ō·ḏə·p̄îm bā·hem
verses.literal: Give the money to Aaron and his sons as the redemption price for the excess among the Israelites
verses.literalPt: e darás a Arão e a seus filhos o dinheiro com o qual são remidos os que são demais entre eles.

verses.original: וַיִּקַּ֣ח מֹשֶׁ֔ה אֵ֖ת כֶּ֣סֶף הַפִּדְי֑וֹם מֵאֵת֙ הָעֹ֣דְפִ֔ים עַ֖ל פְּדוּיֵ֥י הַלְוִיִּֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·qaḥ mō·šeh ’êṯ ke·sep̄ hap·piḏ·yō·wm mê·’êṯ hā·‘ō·ḏə·p̄îm ‘al pə·ḏū·yê hal·wî·yim
verses.literal: So Moses collected the redemption . . . money from those in excess of the number redeemed by the Levites
verses.literalPt: Moisés recebeu o dinheiro da redenção dos que excederam o número dos que foram remidos em lugar dos levitas;

verses.original: מֵאֵ֗ת בְּכ֛וֹר בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לָקַ֣ח אֶת־ הַכָּ֑סֶף חֲמִשָּׁ֨ה וְשִׁשִּׁ֜ים וּשְׁלֹ֥שׁ מֵא֛וֹת וָאֶ֖לֶף בְּשֶׁ֥קֶל הַקֹּֽדֶשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: mê·’êṯ bə·ḵō·wr bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl lā·qaḥ ’eṯ- hak·kā·sep̄ ḥă·miš·šāh wə·šiš·šîm ū·šə·lōš mê·’ō·wṯ wā·’e·lep̄ bə·še·qel haq·qō·ḏeš
verses.literal: He collected the money from the firstborn of the Israelites 1,365 . . . . . . . . . . . . shekels according to the sanctuary shekel
verses.literalPt: dos primogênitos dos filhos de Israel recebeu ele o dinheiro: mil e trezentos e sessenta e cinco siclos, segundo o siclo do santuário.

verses.original: וַיִּתֵּ֨ן מֹשֶׁ֜ה אֶת־ כֶּ֧סֶף הַפְּדֻיִ֛ם לְאַהֲרֹ֥ן וּלְבָנָ֖יו עַל־ פִּ֣י יְהוָ֑ה כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת־ מֹשֶֽׁה׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·yit·tên mō·šeh ’eṯ- ke·sep̄ hap·pə·ḏu·yim lə·’a·hă·rōn ū·lə·ḇā·nāw ‘al- pî Yah·weh ka·’ă·šer ṣiw·wāh Yah·weh ’eṯ- mō·šeh
verses.literal: And Moses gave the redemption money to Aaron and his sons in obedience to the word of the LORD just as the LORD had commanded him
verses.literalPt: Moisés deu o dinheiro da redenção a Arão e a seus filhos, segundo a palavra de Jeová, como Jeová ordenou a Moisés.
